tier_names.J: between two functions of its own class that are in this file (96% right on held-out checks)
tier_names.Z: library class named like one upstream library file (a library placement, not a Roblox path)
tier_names.Y: class name matches a file name in the builds we hold (about 63% right; the weakest placement)
tier_names.W: same RTTI class, counting weak placements too (a guess about a guess)
tier_names.V: same RTTI class, split across files; one file holds most of it (weaker than U)
tier_names.Q: property initializer, with its get/set accessors (18 of 18 right on held-out checks)
tier_names.H: same instruction pattern and size as its neighbours in this file (about 97% right on held-out checks)
tier_names.G: named by similarity to the iOS/Android Ghidra exports
tier_names.T: template of a class in this file
tier_names.B: tiny stub right after a function of this file
tier_names.K: only called from this file (about 70% right on held-out checks)
tier_names.m: class defined in exactly one file of the 2016 leak or the iOS build, and that file is nearby (about 63% right)
tier_names.A: last resort: the nearest placed function by address (about 76% right in general, less for these leftovers)
tier_names.M: same class and method defined in this file in the 2016 leak
